elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(1) expressly warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) warrants that the Site, the core developed deliverable, will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation agreed by the Parties.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The Site conformance warranty lasts only 90 days, not 12 months.
The 90-day period applies only to Site conformance under Section 9(c)(2); no duration is stated for the Services performance warranty in Section 9(c)(1).

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedy provision expressly includes repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site, at HDI's option.
The remedy provision expressly includes a refund of amounts paid to HDI for non-conforming Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(4) warrants that HDI's performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(3) covers the Site and software or files delivered by HDI, but does not expressly extend the malicious-code warranty to the Services themselves.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 9(c)(2) warrants that the Site, as the developed software deliverable, will conform to agreed specifications and documentation for 90 days after written acceptance.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: The Services performance warranty has no express duration; the stated 90-day period is limited to Site conformance and does not establish a 30-day Services warranty period.
